caching.description: Consolidated caching parameters that dictate the update threshold window for CachingHardware wrappers to drop redundant I2C writes.

intake_tolerance.description: Power variance tolerance (0.0 to 1.0) for the front and mid intake rollers. If the new command is within this range of the previous write, it is skipped. Recommended: 0.01.

flywheel_tolerance.description: Velocity variance tolerance (in encoder ticks per second) below which new speed adjustment commands are dropped to prevent minor noise from saturating the I2C bus. Recommended: 0.005.

hood_tolerance.description: Servo position variance tolerance (0.0 to 1.0) below which new position commands are ignored. Reduces servo jitter. Recommended: 0.002.

drivetrain_tolerance.description: Motor power variance tolerance (0.0 to 1.0) for chassis wheels. Crucial for reducing loop times. Recommended: 0.02.

turret.description: Turret system mechanical and hardware configuration.

max_turn_power.description: Upper speed limit (0.0 to 1.0) allowed for chassis turn adjustments when auto-aligning to the goal. Recommended: 0.5.

min_turn_power.description: Minimum power (0.0 to 1.0) sent to the drivetrain during auto-turn corrections. Overcomes static wheel friction (stiction). If the robot stops turning before aligning, increase this. Recommended: 0.12.

max_power_output.description: Maximum power limit (0.0 to 1.0) commanded to the turret CRServo. Limits maximum turret rotation speed. Recommended: 0.5.

feed_forward.description: Feedforward power component (0.0 to 1.0) added to turret rotation to overcome gear backlash and friction. Applied in the direction of movement. Recommended: 0.08.

orientation.description: Mounting directions of the Control Hub IMU orientation.

logo.description: Mounting orientation direction of the hub's logo panel (e.g. RIGHT, LEFT, UP, DOWN, FORWARD, BACKWARD).

usb.description: Mounting direction of the hub's USB ports.

offset_const.description: Encoder-to-angle mapping offset (degrees) to align the physical turret zero orientation with the chassis.

limit_const.description: Mechanical rotation boundary (degrees) measured from center. Prevents the turret from rotating past this limit and tearing internal wires.

sentinel.description: Robot physical footprint and score goal zone boundaries.

robot_width.description: Total physical width of the robot (inches) used to build the collision footprint. Determines how close the robot can get to walls or goals.

rotation_lookahead.description: Angle (radians) used to project the robot's future rotation. If the robot would violate a goal zone at this lookahead angle, it prevents the turn. Recommended: 0.45.

goals.description: Dimensions of the square scoring zones.

size.description: Length (inches) of one side of the square scoring goal zones on the field.

min_y.description: The Y-coordinate boundary (inches) on the field where the scoring zones begin. Used to calculate red/blue alliance goal boxes.

casablanca.description: Collision avoidance safety buffers and repulsion powers.

power.description: Motor power (0.0 to 1.0) commanded to push the robot away when it violates a goal zone boundary. Recommended: 0.12.

decel_safety_factor.description: Scale factor (0.0 to 1.0) for predictive braking. Lowering this makes braking engage sooner/more aggressively to guarantee the robot doesn't enter the goal zone. Recommended: 0.7.

slow_down.description: Distance (inches) from the goal zone at which forward/backward speed reduction warning starts. Recommended: 8.0.

hard_stop.description: Distance (inches) from the goal zone where forward/backward drive power towards the zone is cut to zero. Recommended: 10.0.

slow_down.description: Distance (inches) from the goal zone at which lateral (strafing) speed reduction warning starts. Recommended: 4.0.

hard_stop.description: Distance (inches) from the goal zone where lateral (strafing) drive power towards the zone is cut to zero. Recommended: 3.0.

lane_blend_distance.description: Distance (inches) over which safety slows downs are interpolated from 0% to 100% strength to prevent jerky speed changes. Recommended: 12.0.

shooter.description: Shooter flywheel speed tuning, PIDF gains, and launch parameters.

max_rpm.description: Maximum rotational speed (RPM) of the shooter motor. Used to scale power percentage to velocity.

min_transfer_threshold.description: Flywheel speed threshold (percentage, 0.0 to 1.0) required to trigger the transfer belt. Prevents launching rings before the shooter is up to speed. Recommended: 0.93.

pidf.description: PIDF coefficients for the shooter motor velocity loop.

p.description: Proportional gain. Corrects for instantaneous speed drops.

i.description: Integral gain. Corrects steady-state speed errors.

f.description: Feedforward gain. Crucial for matching target speed directly. Recommended: 22.8.

launch_params.description: Distance tables and launch calculation coefficients.

threshold_distance.description: Distance boundary (inches) separating close-range shots from long-range shots.

launch_power.description: Flywheel power ratio (0.0 to 1.0) used for close-range shots. Recommended: 0.59.

wait_time.description: Delay (milliseconds) to keep the flywheel running after firing a near shot. Recommended: 2000.0.

base_power.description: Base flywheel power ratio (0.0 to 1.0) for Blue alliance shots beyond the threshold distance. Recommended: 0.58.

red_base_power.description: Base flywheel power ratio (0.0 to 1.0) for Red alliance shots beyond the threshold distance. Recommended: 0.60.

power_scale.description: Distance divisor (inches) to scale up flywheel power as distance increases (power = base_power + extra_distance / power_scale). Recommended: 300.0.

wait_time_scale.description: Multiplier converting distance to run-time (wait_time = distance * wait_time_scale) in milliseconds. Recommended: 68.0.

turret.description: Turret targeting PIDF loop gains and tolerances.

pidf.description: PIDF coefficients for the turret yaw control loop.

max_drift.description: Maximum allowed chassis drift (inches) from target pose before auto-corrective drive motions engage. Recommended: 3.0.

near_cutoff.description: Distance boundary (inches) below which the target is considered close, switching to static tolerance. Recommended: 1.0.

near_val.description: Target alignment tolerance (degrees) when within the near cutoff range. Recommended: 45.0.

min_deg.description: Minimum dynamic alignment tolerance (degrees) allowed. Prevents the turret from hunting indefinitely when very close. Recommended: 0.5.

max_deg.description: Maximum dynamic alignment tolerance (degrees) allowed. Prevents launching if the turret orientation error exceeds this. Recommended: 2.0.

casablanca.description: Casablanca driver assistance, stiction compensation, and smoothing gains.

x.description: Minimum forward/backward drive power (0.0 to 1.0) needed to overcome static wheel stiction. Calibrated using Friction Calibration OpMode. Recommended: 0.10.

y.description: Minimum lateral/strafing drive power (0.0 to 1.0) needed to overcome static wheel stiction. Calibrated using Friction Calibration OpMode. Recommended: 0.20.

rot.description: Minimum turn/yaw drive power (0.0 to 1.0) needed to overcome static wheel stiction. Calibrated using Friction Calibration OpMode. Recommended: 0.12.

time.description: Joystick input filter time constant (seconds). Higher values make acceleration and deceleration smoother but increase input lag. Recommended: 0.22.

back_lift_multiplier.description: Divisor scaling factor for deceleration. Divides the deceleration rate when stopping to slow down the deceleration curve, preventing the robot from tipping forward and lifting its back wheels. Recommended: 2.5.

enabled.description: Enable/disable automatic heading lock when the driver releases the turn joystick in TeleOp.

kp.description: Proportional gain for the heading lock controller. Higher values correct heading errors more aggressively. Recommended: 0.8.

max_power.description: Maximum motor power (0.0 to 1.0) the heading lock is allowed to command. Clamped to be completely imperceptible to the driver. Recommended: 0.04.

deadband.description: Joystick threshold (0.0 to 1.0) below which the heading lock engages. Recommended: 0.01.

drink_wait_ms.description: Wait delay (milliseconds) at the drink gate when intake gathers rings. Recommended: 1200.

shoot_wait_ms.description: Wait time (milliseconds) allowed to fire a shot before ending the shoot command. Recommended: 1300.

launch_power.description: Target power coefficient (0.0 to 1.0) for autonomous launcher velocity scaling. Recommended: 0.71.

transfer_power.description: Target power coefficient (0.0 to 1.0) for autonomous transfer motor. Recommended: 0.12.
